description: This file defines an interface 'UriFactoryInterface' in the PSR HTTP Message namespace, which declares a method for creating URI objects. It is part of a PSR standards package related to HTTP message interfaces, specifically for creating URI instances.

classes.name: UriFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method for creating URI instances from string representations.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a URI object from a string, or returns a default URI if no string is provided. Throws InvalidArgumentException if the input URI string cannot be parsed.
